plainText:
(Japanese: ポケットモンスターＢ・Ｗ　伝説との遭遇 Pocket Monsters BW: Meetings with the Legends) is a created by Momota Inoue. It is a one-shot comic based on the games . It was published in the Winter 2010 issue of the CoroCoro G magazine, which is published twice a year.

==Plot==
 
This manga revolves around the adventures of a young boy named Touya, who travels through the Unova region, battling many Pokémon, meeting various people, including the malevolent Team Plasma and a mysterious boy named N.
